# Don't fall over

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Timeouts
- What: Give every outside call a time limit, so a hanging service cannot freeze the app.
- Applies when: the app calls outside services.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Every outside call has a time limit. With a service that hangs, the app gives up and tells the user.

### Retry
- What: Try a failed call again after a short wait, a limited number of times.
- Applies when: the app calls outside services.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: A call that fails briefly is retried a few times with growing waits, then gives up with a clear error. Errors that can never succeed are not retried.

### Circuit breaker
- What: Stop calling a service that keeps failing, and try again later.
- Applies when: an outside service fails often under real use.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Error handling
- What: Catch failures, show the user a plain message, and log the details.
- Applies when: every app.
- Stage: day-one
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: cross-cutting
- Proof: test
- Done when: A failure shows the user a plain message and is logged with detail. No raw error or stack trace reaches the screen.

### Idempotency
- What: Make sure an action sent twice, by a double click or a retry, happens only once.
- Applies when: an action must never happen twice, such as a payment, an order or an email.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: The same request sent twice, by a double click or a retry, has the effect of one.

### Fallback
- What: Have a backup answer or service ready when the main one fails.
- Applies when: a feature should keep working when one part fails.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Graceful degradation
- What: Keep the rest of a feature working when one part of it fails.
- Applies when: a feature should keep working when one part fails.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Free-first cascade
- What: Try free sources of data first, and pay for a call only when they come up empty.
- Applies when: the app pays per call for data it could often get free.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Concurrency gate
- What: Limit how many heavy requests run at the same time.
- Applies when: heavy requests arrive faster than the app can serve them.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Single-flight
- What: When many identical requests arrive together, do the work once and share the answer.
- Applies when: many identical requests arrive at once.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Per-host pacing
- What: Space out calls to each outside service so you stay under its rate limits.
- Applies when: the app calls rate-limited outside services heavily.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Quota ledger
- What: Keep one shared count of a limited key's usage across all workers.
- Applies when: several workers share one limited key.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Load shedding
- What: Turn some requests away quickly when overloaded, so the rest still succeed.
- Applies when: traffic can exceed capacity.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Degrade under quota
- What: When a paid quota runs out, switch to a cheaper or reduced mode instead of failing.
- Applies when: the app can run out of a paid quota.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Rate limiting
- What: Cap how many requests each caller can make in a period of time.
- Applies when: the app is going live with public or costly endpoints.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable
